clues: This city lies just west of a great crack that splits its land in two. Hot springs bubble in the high hills around its streets.
The long wet time here comes in summer, yet it is the coldest time of year. Rain, hail, and thick cloud make the days dark and chilly.
A king made this town by the hot springs in 1886 and built his palace here. In 1889 it became the capital of his empire.
This city's name means new flower in the Amharic tongue. It is a bright, fresh name for a city founded in 1886.
This city is where Ethiopia's leaders run the land. Its parliament meets here, and the prime minister works here too.
